name: hud_ui_options_panel_resolution_on_activate
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_Resolution::OnActivate advances the resolution selector and stores the selected deferred video mode for the main-menu transition.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40ce80 calls HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::AdvanceSelectionAndActivate, switches on the resulting selectedIndex, and calls RecoilStateMainMenuTransition::SetDeferredVideoModeIndex for cases 0 through 5.

The selected-index mapping is 0 to ZVID_MODE_640X480, 1 to ZVID_MODE_320X240_TO_640X480, 2 to ZVID_MODE_640X400, 3 to ZVID_MODE_320X200_TO_640X400, 4 to ZVID_MODE_800X600, and 5 to ZVID_MODE_1024X768. The switch has no default write.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_resolution_on_activate_smoke verifies the advance-before-switch behavior, all six deferred-video-mode cases, wrap-to-case-zero behavior, and that an advanced selectedIndex outside the switch leaves the deferred mode unchanged.
